styles.name: Dorfcomic
styles.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: real transparent PNG game sprite atlas, NOT a mockup, NOT a presentation board. This is production source material for a browser 2D RPG. Canvas landscape 2048x1024. EXACTLY 8 columns and 4 rows, 32 equal 256x256 cells. No grid lines, no text, no labels, no background, no floor, no cast shadows. Genuine transparent alpha outside the characters. Every cell contains one complete uncropped character, with generous empty margin. All feet in each row sit on the same cell baseline y=220, all characters centered at x=128. Keep body height and costume absolutely constant within each row. Fixed elevated 3/4 front view facing screen-right, sunlight from upper left; do not change camera between frames.
Row 1, all eight cells: Aperol-Anni, adult blonde woman, high hair bun, sunglasses perched on head, orange floral blouse, cream gingham country-house apron, dark green trousers, brown boots, gold hoop earrings. Small makeup brush in right hand and cleaner spray clipped to waist, no floating props.
Row 2: Dosen-Dieter, stocky adult rural German man, brown moustache, short brown hair, faded dark teal sleeveless denim vest, cream shirt, brown trousers and boots, small metal bottle-cap ladle in right hand. No beer crate.
Row 3: Grill-Oskar, friendly stout adult village cook, short black hair, red bandana, plain white shirt, russet grilling apron, dark trousers and boots, short barbecue tongs in right hand. No writing on apron.
Row 4: an aggressive brown wild boar, tusks, darker back bristles, short sturdy legs, anatomically clear animal silhouette, no clothes or extra props.
In EVERY row, the eight columns in order are distinct actual animation keyframes:
1 neutral standing idle; 2 walking right with near leg forward and far leg back; 3 walking passing pose, legs under hips; 4 walking right with far leg forward and near leg back; 5 attack anticipation body leans back and active arm pulled back (boar crouches); 6 attack impact arm thrust forward (boar lunges head and tusks forward); 7 recoil/hit flinch torso backward, face clenched (boar recoils); 8 resting/catching breath with shoulders lowered (boar lowered head). Poses must genuinely change limbs and silhouettes. No duplicate poses, no motion blur, no speed lines, no effects, no weapon detached from hand, no extra limbs. Crisp pixel art with hand-authored-looking intentional clusters, no painterly gradients, no vector smoothing. This is one unified art family across all four rows.
STYLE A — DORFCOMIC: classic charming high-quality comic pixel art. Each human is designed on a 32px logical body grid, about 28px tall, enlarged with exact square nearest-neighbor pixel blocks inside the cell. Restrained 24-color palette, one dark slate outer pixel contour, three clear flat shade bands, honey highlights, coral orange and teal accents. Moderate big heads (about one third body height), clean strong readable silhouettes, expressive eyebrows. Distinct chunky pixels, zero subpixel detail. Clear hand-placed pixel clusters, neither shiny nor photorealistic.
